title: India's Green Hydrogen Push: New Boost for Clean Energy Production
description: India is actively promoting "Green Hydrogen," a clean fuel made using renewable energy. The government recently announced new steps to boost its production an.

faq.q: What is the main goal of the National Green Hydrogen Mission?
faq.a: The main goal is to make India a global hub for the production, usage, and export of Green Hydrogen and its derivatives, aiming for energy independence and decarbonisation of the economy.
An electrolyser is a device that uses electricity to split water (H₂O) into hydrogen (H₂) and oxygen (O₂). It's a key technology for producing Green Hydrogen.

faq.q: Which industries will use Green Hydrogen first?
faq.a: Initially, Green Hydrogen is expected to be used in sectors that are difficult to decarbonise, such as fertiliser production, petroleum refining, steel manufacturing, and heavy-duty transportation.

faq.q: How much investment is planned for this mission?
faq.a: The National Green Hydrogen Mission has an initial outlay of ₹19,744 crore, which includes funding for the SIGHT Programme, pilot projects, R&D, and other support mechanisms.
